comments.text:
Implemented the three hero items in src/pages/index.js:

- Subhead: "We build the system, run it in production, and your experts keep it aligned." (replaces "We solve your business problems with AI, then run it securely in production.") H1 "Depend on proven experts" unchanged.
- Hero proof line (new, above the button, under the subhead): "A quarter billion dollars processed in production, at nearly 100% uptime." Pulled from the intro paragraph just below the hero, which now keeps only the other number ("180 billion tokens of production LLM workload. AI in production, not just in demos.") so the two numbers aren't duplicated.
- Hero button: label "Tell us the problem" kept; now an internal Gatsby <Link to="/engage"> instead of the external contactUrl form link, className="button" unchanged. Read src/pages/engage.js first — its lead paragraph ("An engagement means Anthus runs the system for you. Your experts stay in the loop...") lines up with the new hero subhead's "your experts keep it aligned," so the handoff reads as one continuous claim.

Also implemented 959bf4's items 1-4 (B0rd removal, single contact button, case-card restructuring, SEO/footer copy cleanup) in the same file — see that task's comment for details. Ran prettier --write/--check on src/pages/index.js and src/components/index.module.css; both clean. Did not run build/dev. Left both tasks in_progress; not committed/pushed.
